source: The reference controller of solution/ (it finds the remote in the camera images it asks for; nothing is privileged) on the 12 fixed hidden episodes of tests/hidden/episodes.json, measured by `ale validate`. The episodes are draws the reference retrieves the remote in (tests/review/select_episodes.py and its record tests/hidden/selection.json), so the value is 1.0 by construction and the oracle's run repeats it. Measured: mean_retrieval_score 1.0 (12 of 12 retrieved) in the oracle episode of validate-721bbb1b on engine bfb7505, 2026-11-26.
note: The metric is the mean over the episodes of an episode's score: 1 for the remote retrieved, 0.4 for the remote laid open, 0.2 for the remote seen in an image the controller asked for, else 0. A fixed episode set and a deterministic simulator leave no seed spread: full_at 0.98 only absorbs rounding.
